KA-065.rationale: Regression testing is an input to integrity validation and must not depend on the validators that consume its result.

KA-117.rationale: Knowledge integrity consumes regression and contradiction evidence before persistence; the system-wide auditor is downstream.

KA-1099.rationale: The system integrity audit aggregates completed regression and knowledge-integrity results.

KA-1111.rationale: Goal-drift monitoring evaluates history and long-horizon plans before the evolution controller admits an action.

KA-1100.rationale: Evolution admission consumes escalation, capability, and prior goal-drift constraints; it is not a prerequisite of the monitor.
